root_idea.summary: The root centers on صُوفٌ, wool, especially the fleece of sheep.
root_idea.development: The principal semantic line extends from wool to descriptions of animals or hair as woolly, wool-like materials, and associated derivatives. The lexicon also records a separate turn-aside branch for صَافَ and أَصَافَ.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular dictionary citation form صُوفٌ; the supplied Quran form is its plural أَصْوَاف.

senses.definition: Wool, the fleece or hair covering of sheep used as a material.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural أَصْوَاف and refers collectively to the wool of the animals mentioned in its context, alongside camel fur and animal hair.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a ram with much wool, of a hair-lock described as wool-like, and through a feminine form of a ewe.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn aside or away; to be turned away; to turn something away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an arrow turning aside from its target, a face turning away, or evil or mischief turning away; the Form IV construction can mean turning evil away from someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a grapevine, to show its fruitstalks again after its fruit has been cut off.
To become a devotee or Sufi; a member of the Sufi community, especially a devotee or mystic.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This usage is explicitly described as post-Classical; تَصَوَّفَ may also describe someone claiming or undertaking such religious devotion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single portion, tuft, flock, or wisp of wool.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular noun may denote a particular portion of wool; صُوفٌ can sometimes be used in this count-noun sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression أَخَذَ بِصُوفِ رَقَبَتِهِ, to seize someone by the nape or by force, or to overtake someone after pursuing him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is variously explained literally by reference to the pendent or downy hair at the nape, or more broadly as taking hold of someone or overtaking him.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give something altogether, or to give it gratuitously without taking payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression distinct from the corresponding expression for seizing or overtaking someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A proverb for someone who obtains property without knowing its value and wastes it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is also applied to a foolish or inept person who finds property and spoils it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wool-like marine substance, identified as seaweed or similar material cast onto beaches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is literal in form but names a material resembling wool rather than animal fleece.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wool pessary or suppository containing a medicament.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical medical use for an insert placed in the vagina or rectum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pre-Islamic group associated with serving the Kaaba and conducting pilgrims from ʿArafāt; by extension, a servant of the Kaaba.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The historical identification and derivation of the group name are reported in more than one way, but the association with Kaaba service is explicit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A downy herb or leguminous plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plant is described as short and covered with fine down; these forms are distinct from the separately attested fungus sense of صُوفَانٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flaccid, dry fungus or tree-born substance used as tinder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical or regional plant-material designation for a substance especially suitable for striking fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A maker or manufacturer of wool or woollen garments.
A wool-rich garment of the type called جُبَّة.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the plural أَصْوَاف; the public headword is normalized to the singular citation form صُوفٌ.
The Classical turn-aside meanings of صَافَ and أَصَافَ are kept separate from the Quranic wool sense.
